body.purpose: Simplified Chinese UI and status text.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled action for translating or confirming a send.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 38px; border: 1px solid var(--field-rule, #808897); border-radius: var(--control, 8px); padding: 7px 12px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #20242c); font: 650 14px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--accent, #c34200); color: var(--accent, #c34200); } .ds-primary:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-soft, #fff3e9); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-active, #872d00); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary:disabled { border-color: var(--rule, #e0e3e9); background: var(--panel, #f6f7f9); color: var(--muted, #59616f); cursor: default; } .ds-primary:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent, #c34200); border-color: var(--accent, #c34200); color: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-hover, #a73600); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #a73600); color: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-primary:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-active, #872d00); border-color: var(--accent-active, #872d00); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined action for canceling confirmation or managing the key.
components.css: .ds-secondary { min-height: 38px; border: 1px solid var(--field-rule, #808897); border-radius: var(--control, 8px); padding: 7px 12px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #20242c); font: 650 14px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--accent, #c34200); color: var(--accent, #c34200); } .ds-secondary:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-soft, #fff3e9); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-active, #872d00); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { border-color: var(--rule, #e0e3e9); background: var(--panel, #f6f7f9); color: var(--muted, #59616f); cursor: default; }

components.name: Restore Button
components.description: Transparent secondary action that restores the original page text.
components.css: .ds-restore { min-height: 38px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--control, 8px); padding: 7px 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #20242c); font: 650 14px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-restore:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--accent, #c34200); } .ds-restore:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-active, #872d00); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-restore:disabled { color: var(--muted, #59616f); cursor: default; }

components.name: API Key Field
components.description: Labeled password field for a user-supplied DeepSeek API Key.
components.html: <label class="ds-key">DeepSeek API Key<input type="password" autocomplete="off" placeholder="粘贴你的 API Key"></label>
components.css: .ds-key { display: block; color: var(--ink, #20242c); font: 650 12px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-key input { display: block; margin-top: 4px; min-height: 38px; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--field-rule, #808897); border-radius: var(--control, 8px); color: var(--ink, #20242c); caret-color: var(--accent, #c34200); background: var(--surface, #fff); font: 14px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-key input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #59616f); opacity: 1; } .ds-key input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-active, #872d00); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Language Route
components.description: Read-only source and destination in the popup masthead.
components.html: 英文简体中文
components.css: .ds-route { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--muted, #59616f); font: 650 12px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-route > :last-child { color: var(--accent, #c34200); } .ds-direction { position: relative; width: 12px; height: 1px; background: var(--muted, #59616f); } .ds-direction::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -2px; right: 0; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-top: 1px solid var(--muted, #59616f); border-right: 1px solid var(--muted, #59616f); transform: rotate(45deg); }

components.name: Send Confirmation
components.description: Inline consent for sending the current page text to DeepSeek.
components.html:
确认发送正文

将当前页面可翻译的正文发送至 DeepSeek。该确认仅对当前页面有效。
components.css: .ds-consent { padding: 12px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--accent-soft, #fff3e9); color: var(--ink, #20242c); font: 14px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-consent h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; } .ds-consent p { margin: 4px 0 12px; } .ds-consent-actions { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; } .ds-consent-actions button { min-height: 38px; border: 1px solid var(--field-rule, #808897); border-radius: var(--control, 8px); padding: 7px 12px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #20242c); font: 650 14px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-consent-actions button:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--accent, #c34200); color: var(--accent, #c34200); } .ds-consent-actions button:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-soft, #fff3e9); } .ds-consent-actions button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-active, #872d00); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-consent-actions button:disabled { border-color: var(--rule, #e0e3e9); background: var(--panel, #f6f7f9); color: var(--muted, #59616f); cursor: default; } .ds-consent-actions .ds-confirm { background: var(--accent, #c34200); border-color: var(--accent, #c34200); color: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-consent-actions .ds-confirm:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-hover, #a73600); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #a73600); color: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-consent-actions .ds-confirm:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-active, #872d00); border-color: var(--accent-active, #872d00); }

components.name: Settings Disclosure
components.description: Shared disclosure for DeepSeek API Key and GitHub interface translation.
components.html:
设置已配置

Key 保存在此浏览器。连接测试使用固定短文本。
components.css: .ds-settings { color: var(--ink, #20242c); font: 14px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-settings summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; list-style: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-settings summary:hover { color: var(--accent, #c34200); } .ds-settings summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-settings summary::after { content: ""; width: 7px; height: 7px; flex: none; border: solid currentColor; border-width: 0 1.5px 1.5px 0; transform: rotate(-45deg); margin-inline: 3px 2px; } .ds-settings[open] summary::after { transform: translateY(-1px) rotate(45deg); } .ds-settings summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-active, #872d00); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-key-state { margin-inline-start: auto; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 20px; color: var(--muted, #59616f); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-key-state[data-configured] { background: var(--success-soft, #eaf5ee); color: var(--success, #176445); } .ds-settings p { color: var(--muted, #59616f); font-size: 12px; margin: 6px 0 10px; } .ds-settings[open] { background: var(--panel, #f6f7f9); }

components.name: GitHub Switch
components.description: Independent local interface translation setting for GitHub.
components.css: .ds-github { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 4px 16px; padding: 12px 0 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #e0e3e9); color: var(--ink, #20242c); font: 14px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-github strong { display: block; font-weight: 650; } .ds-github small { display: block; color: var(--muted, #59616f); font-size: 12px; } .ds-github input { appearance: none; position: relative; width: 44px; height: 26px; margin: 0; background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--field-rule, #808897); border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-github input::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 3px auto 3px 3px; width: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--muted, #59616f); transition: transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-github input:checked { background: var(--accent, #c34200); border-color: var(--accent, #c34200); } .ds-github input:checked::before { transform: translateX(18px); background: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-github input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-active, #872d00); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-github input:disabled { opacity: .65; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-github input::before { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview: Yoread is a compact desktop Chrome utility. Alibaba Fusion informs the clear control hierarchy. The white workspace leads with page status and actions. A single disclosure groups DeepSeek and GitHub configuration. Warm orange marks the primary action and the translation destination.
